template.name: Computer / IT equipment – Class I – AS/NZS 3551 EST
template.desc: Class I (earthed) computer, laptop power supply, monitor or other IT equipment. Limits from AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2 Appendix B: earth resistance 0.2 ohm (fixed lead or detachable lead alone) or 0.1 ohm (appliance inlet to earthed metal); insulation over 1 Mohm at 500 V; touch current 100 uA normal, 500 uA neutral open or earth open; earth leakage 5000 uA normal, 10000 uA neutral open. Non-medical equipment in the patient environment must meet the touch current limits (clause 6.1).

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Unplug the equipment before inspecting. Do not open the case.

items: Mains lead: plug, cable and connector undamaged; plug pins straight and secure; strain relief intact.
Case undamaged: no cracks, missing screws, heat marks or signs of liquid.
Ports, sockets and switches undamaged; no loose connectors.
Labels legible: model, ratings and the Class I (earthed) marking.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply. Nothing needs to be connected to the equipment outlet for this step.

steps.title: Detachable mains lead: earth continuity
steps.instructions:
Only for equipment with a detachable lead (appliance inlet). Mark this step skipped for a fixed lead.
Test the lead on its own, disconnected from the equipment.
1. Plug the lead into the ESA612 equipment outlet.
2. Clip the red test lead to the earth contact inside the connector (C13/C5).
Limit 0.2 ohm (AS/NZS 3551 B8.4).

steps.title: Earth bond: fixed lead
steps.instructions:
Only for equipment with a fixed (non-detachable) lead. Mark this step skipped for a detachable lead.
Plug the equipment into the ESA612 equipment outlet, switched off. Clip the red test lead to an unpainted, earthed metal part of the case (a screw or a metal port shell). Test more than one point if there are separate earthed metal parts.
Measured from the earth pin of the mains plug: limit 0.2 ohm (B8.2, B8.6).

steps.title: Earth bond: appliance inlet
steps.instructions:
Only for equipment with a detachable lead. Mark this step skipped for a fixed lead.
The limit is 0.1 ohm from the earth pin in the appliance inlet to the earthed metal parts (B8.3, B8.6), not including the lead. A reading through the lead that is 0.1 ohm or less passes. If it reads higher, measure again from the earth pin in the inlet itself (test leads) and record that; the lead step above covers the lead.
Plug the equipment into the ESA612 equipment outlet with its lead, switched off. Clip the red test lead to an unpainted, earthed metal part of the case.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions:
Mains pins (live and neutral linked by the ESA612) to the earth pin, at 500 V. Switch the equipment on if it has a switch, and disconnect all peripherals and network cables.
Must be over 1 Mohm. If it is under 10 Mohm, it must be at least 80% of the acceptance test value (B9.3). A surge protector (MOV) can cause a low reading: if so, document it and repeat at 250 V.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to accessible non-earthed parts
steps.instructions:
Only for equipment with accessible parts that are not connected to earth (isolated ports, a plastic case with metal screws, isolated metal). Mark this step skipped if every accessible part is earthed.
Clip the red test lead to the part, or link several parts together with a shorting clip or foil. Must be over 1 Mohm (B9.3). For a detachable power supply (plug pack), test from mains to its low-voltage output terminals.

steps.title: Touch current
steps.instructions: Equipment on, peripherals disconnected. Red test lead on a representative accessible conductive part, or on foil wrapped around a plastic case. Limits: 100 uA normal, 500 uA neutral open, 500 uA earth open (B10.5). Non-medical equipment in the patient environment must meet these (clause 6.1), otherwise it goes on a separation transformer.

steps.title: Earth leakage
steps.instructions: Flexible-cord Class I equipment (B11). Use a detachable lead of the length normally used. Equipment on, peripherals disconnected. Limits: 5000 uA normal, 10000 uA neutral open (B11.6). Mark this step skipped for permanently wired equipment.

steps.title: Power on and function
steps.instructions: Do this after the electrical safety tests.

items: Powers on and reaches the operating system without error messages.
Fans run and vents are clear of dust and blockage.
Screen, keyboard and pointing device work; connected peripherals work.
Equipment clean and fit for the clinical area; test label applied.
